title: Approaching the Harm of Gradient Attacks While Only Flipping Labels
abstract: arXiv:2503.00140v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine learning systems deployed in distributed or federated environments are highly susceptible to adversarial manipulations, particularly availability attacks -- rendering the trained model unavailable. Prior research in distributed ML has demonstrated such adversarial effects through the injection of gradients or data poisoning. In this work, we ask whether comparable degradation is still possible under a substantially more constrained action space: the adversary may only flip a limited number of labels of existing training examples, without modifying features, injecting samples, or directly controlling gradients. We analyze the extent of damage caused by constrained label flipping attacks against distributed learning under mean aggregation -- the dominant baseline in research and production. translated_title: 仅通过翻转标签即可接近梯度攻击的危害
translated_abstract: 部署在分布式或联邦环境中的机器学习系统极易受到对抗性操纵，尤其是可用性攻击——即导致训练出的模型无法正常使用。此前分布式机器学习领域的研究已通过注入梯度或数据投毒的方式证明了这种对抗性效果。在本工作中，我们提出这样一个问题：在实质上更为受限的行动空间下，攻击者是否仍能造成类似的性能下降——即攻击者仅能翻转现有训练样本中的有限数量标签，而不能修改特征、注入样本或直接控制梯度。我们分析了这种受限标签翻转攻击针对采用均值聚合（研究和生产中的主导基线方法）的分布式学习所能造成的损害程度。聚焦于分类问题，(1) 我们提出了一种新颖的标签翻转攻击形式化方法，将其建模为每轮受限优化问题……
tldr: 本文证明，即使攻击者只能翻转有限数量的训练标签而无法修改特征、注入样本或控制梯度，仍能对基于均值聚合的分布式学习造成与梯度攻击相当的破坏。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that adversaries, even when restricted to only flipping a limited number of training labels—without modifying features, injecting samples, or controlling gradients—can still inflict damage on distributed learning with mean aggregation comparable to that of gradient attacks.
